exact_theorems: Positive 1-in-3 is exact cover of clause vertices by variable-occurrence hyperedges.
If every variable occurs at most twice, the dual rank is <=2 and the problem reduces exactly to graph matching saturating all clause vertices.

source_threshold.statement: k-bounded Positive 1-in-3-SAT is polynomial for k<=2 and NP-complete for k>=3.
source_threshold.source: Using clausal graphs to determine the computational complexity of k-bounded positive one-in-three SAT, Discrete Applied Mathematics 157(7), 2009.

active_gate.target: Poly witness-preserving contraction of rank-3 exact-cover interactions into rank<=2 matching or another proved tractable carrier.
